observations: QR stand, before the edit: a flat white sign with a thin black frame and a small black QR, on a thin black easel pole, at about x35-128, y295-580.

QR stand, after the edit: in the same spot and at about the same height (about x30-133, y290-585). It is now a grey rounded kiosk with a teal frame around an abstract block pattern and a teal bar under it. It stands on a slim grey column with a round grey base near the floor at about y570. It has no text and no readable real code.

Match with 03-1: 03-1 shows a grey tilted kiosk with a white face, dark grey blocks and a teal bar underneath, on a grey column and base. The new 04-1 kiosk has the same housing, column, base and teal bar.
Match with 03-3: the 03-3 close-up shows a grey housing with a thick teal frame around dark blocks. The new 04-1 kiosk also has the teal frame, so the two read as the same prop.

Small difference, not blocking: the blocks in 04-1 are teal or dark teal, while 03-1 and 03-3 use dark grey or black. At this small size in a wide shot the kiosk still clearly reads as the same grey-and-teal check-in kiosk.
The rest of the panel looks unchanged. I compared these areas one by one:
- Ravi: same pose, position and size, same smile and upward gaze. His left hand grips the brown bag strap with the watch on that wrist, and his right hand is in his trouser pocket.
- Chairs and background: the two front blue chairs to his right are still empty. The grey-shirted man and the brown-clad bun-haired woman are still seen from behind, and the plant is unchanged.
- TV: the light-teal screen with its empty white strip is unchanged.
- Right side: the glass door, Meera with her braid typing at the monitor, the desk plant and the vitals cart with its cuff, oximeter and monitor are unchanged.
- Window and caption area: the left window column and the hard-edged white caption block at the upper left (edges at about x52 and y228) are unchanged.
- I saw no new artefacts, text or numbers anywhere.

- Ravi matches main-cast.png: side-parted short black hair, trimmed beard, thick straight brows, light green shirt with rolled sleeves, dark trousers, watch on the left wrist and dark-brown shoulder bag.
- Meera matches her sheet: patterned blue kurta and side braid.
- The panel still fits the source line 'slot comes up on the waiting-room TV and he stands' and the 03-5 to 04-1 continuity, with the two seats empty and only Ravi left.

One problem noted before still applies and is not blocking: the white caption block at the upper left cuts across the left window column. It was there before the edit and was already noted as not blocking in r10. Most of it will be covered by the caption.
